# `tests/test_setup.py`

[As built](../../README.md) › `test_setup.py`

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Tests the six setup stations that initialize a new machine: verifying infrastructure, connecting to providers, configuring harnesses, selecting the agent crew, setting cost limits, and finishing setup. Tests verify what the app writes to config, how the screen displays status, and HTTP endpoints without requiring Docker or network.

464 lines, a test.
